text:
Priya: FYI opened a small migration PR to update the SDK snippets in the 'region-aware-auth' docs. Old Ruby + Go examples still reference `REGION_NAME` env var and 'onprem' wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3480 — can someone sanity-check wording and samples?
Jorge: Looking. Noticed the Ruby snippet uses `ENV['REGION_NAME']` and then maps to zone codes. We should switch to region slugs `eu`, `apac`, `na` per the platform contract.
Tasha: Also we need to be careful with the residency blurb. Legal wants a specific phrasing for on-prem vs private: see legal-bot note below.
docs-bot: CI / docs/link-check failed on docs/region-auth.md: broken anchor `#on-prem-deployments` (line 58).
Priya: Thanks. I'll fix the anchor and update internal links. Jorge, can you propose the new Ruby and Go examples?
Jorge: Proposed Ruby: ```ruby
# ruby example
client = Redwood::Client.new(model: 'redwood/opt-6.7b', headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region' => 'eu' })
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'Hello')
```
Jorge: And Go: ```go
// go example
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{Model: "redwood/opt-6.7b", Headers: map[string]string{"X-Redwood-Region": "eu"}})
res, _ := client.Generate("Hi")
```
Tasha: Legal suggestion: use exact sentence: "Customers enrolled in EU Data Residency have their data stored and processed in EU jurisdictions as described in our Data Residency terms." Link: https://redwood.ai/legal/data-residency
legal-bot: NOTE: For public docs, avoid implying feature availability across plans. Add: 'Availability: Private and Dedicated plans. Contact sales for enrollment.'
Priya: Good catch. I'll add a short 'Availability' bullet under the residency note. Also replacing all `REGION_NAME` env examples with `X-Redwood-Region` header so SDKs are consistent.
Jorge: Small nit: update the matrix row for China/APAC to use `apac` slug, not `cn`. We don't want to imply a mainland China-hosted option unless it's official.
docs-bot: PR #3480 checks 23: snippets linter passed, but link-check failed (broken anchor fixed in pending commit).
Priya: Pushed commit to fix anchor and wording. Also added a changelog entry: 'Docs: region-aware SDK snippet migration (Ruby/Go) and residency phrasing.'
Tasha: I updated the footnote with legal phrasing and availability note. Also added an inline callout for SDK owners to sync the header across clients.
Jorge: Re-ran snippet tests locally; Ruby/Go examples render fine. One remaining TODO: update quickstart script that exports `REGION_NAME` env in examples/quickstart.sh — I'll replace it with `# set X-Redwood-Region header in client` comment.
docs-bot: PR #3480 all checks passed.
Priya: Merged by Priya at 1722223899. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a brief message to #eng-sdk to align client headers. :tada:
